title: SpongeBob Dragon Ride
description: A surreal fantasy scene depicts SpongeBob SquarePants riding in a red Radio Flyer wagon pulled by a large blue dragon breathing fire at a glowing sun orb. A green dog stands on a cracked white spherical character with a mustache and sharp teeth, while a pink ethereal woman emerges from a magical portal on a cliffside with a waterfall.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal fantasy painting shows SpongeBob SquarePants smiling and pointing from a red Radio Flyer wagon labeled Radio Flyer being pulled by a massive blue and white dragon with open wings breathing orange fire toward a bright sun. In the foreground a small green dog stands on a giant cracked white sphere with a mustache sharp teeth and hashtag eyes. To the right a glowing ethereal woman in a flowing pink dress emerges from a circular magical portal with runes surrounded by floating pink petals on a ruined stone cliff with a waterfall. Dramatic stormy sky with lightning dramatic lighting vibrant colors whimsical and chaotic atmosphere.
